notes: DeepFlux 8.5 - System Health tab + player parity. New: a System Health tab (the pulse icon, far right) shows CPU, memory, GPU and VRAM usage, GPU temperature, fan and power, per-disk free space with live read/write speeds, and a hardware inventory list - and it only takes readings while you are looking at it. The agent can now report your system's health and warn you when something runs too hot or a disk gets too full. Also: the mini player gained a Stop button and the S key, and both players now skip time identically (arrow keys and buttons) with arrow up/down volume control.
